$note.headcountHpFactor: Co-op: enemy HP is multiplied by 1 + this × (party size − 1), so each extra body at the table adds one more share of the same fight. 0 leaves a four-hander reading exactly like a solo climb.
$note.mendHealPct: Co-op: percent of an ally's max HP that Mend at a shrine restores.
$note.reviveHp: Co-op: the HP a downed-but-not-dead member comes back at on the next floor.
